notes:
Sphere Bot 1.3.3 fixes managed and team routing permissions, including team owners, and keeps assigned routing separate from permitted Personal Codex and Personal API settings. Revoked permissions refresh in Settings without exposing personal configuration on managed routing.

This update also improves allocation styling, adds the sidebar usage ring with update priority, improves dashboard layouts, and fixes owned computer reconnection. The matching website uses a five-minute idle grace while protecting connected clients and active work.

Existing bots, conversations, files, saved providers and inactive credentials are preserved.
